mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) over two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST shows a sustained increase over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month indicates a robust supply-side response, which boosts economic output and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k & UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% within a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals robust consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% & UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both RSAFS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, indicating inflationary pressure, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a weakening supply-side, which reduces corporate earnings and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO shows a sustained decrease over two months.
